edges.notes: Client page: fetch(`/api/get-participant-token?room=...&username=...`), relative, same origin; the query is dropped. No basePath or rewrites; src/proxy.ts (Clerk) only protects routes. route.ts exports GET

<ChatMessages socketUrl="/api/socket/messages"> passes socketUrl to each <ChatItem>, whose trash icon calls onOpen("deleteMessage", { apiUrl: `${socketUrl}/${id}` }) on the modal store; DeleteMessageModal (delete-message-modal.tsx:34) sends axios.delete(qs.stringifyUrl({ url: data.apiUrl, query })). The page element is the outermost code supplying the path. Pages-router handler admits only DELETE and PATCH (405 otherwise), so labeled with the method; route line is the default export

<ChatMessages apiUrl="/api/messages"> hands apiUrl to useChatQuery (use-chat-query.ts:28), the useInfiniteQuery queryFn's fetch(qs.stringifyUrl({ url: apiUrl, query: { channelId, cursor } })); query dropped. route.ts exports GET

<ChatMessages socketUrl="/api/socket/messages"> passes socketUrl to <ChatItem>, whose edit form sends axios.patch(qs.stringifyUrl({ url: `${socketUrl}/${id}`, query: socketQuery })) (chat-item.tsx:101). Pages-router handler admits only DELETE and PATCH, so labeled with the method; default export line
